children: Nscale Limited ("Nscale"), Aker ASA’s second largest portfolio holding, has today announced that it has filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") relating to a proposed initial public offering of its ordinary shares.
A copy of the registration statement may be obtained on the SEC’s website. The registration statement has been filed with the SEC but has not yet become effective.
Cecilie Langum Becker, Head of Media Relations
Fredrik Berge, Head of Investor Relations

This information has been submitted pursuant to the Securities Trading Act § 5-12 and MAR. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-18 22:02 CEST.

title: Aker ASA: Nscale files registration statement for proposed initial public offering
